outcome: MIS nursery budget workbooks can now be ingested: POST /api/ingest/budget (guarded by the existing 'ingest' grant) parses the Financial MIS Table-2 by its header set, loads every first-of-month date block present into mis_budget as a separate object at paise, and atomically replaces each period's active batch inside one warehouse transaction (prior batches retained, later-period failure rolls back all), never touching SAP actuals. Malformed inputs (mid-month date headers, uncached formulas, duplicate grain, over-cap expansion) are rejected before any write.
